'''Anteevy''' was a frigid ice world locked in a perpetual winter. Located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Esuain sector/Legends|Esuain sector]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbited a [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Anteevy system/Legends|Anteevy system]].

==History==
Discovered sometime between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000]] and [[3000 BBY]], Anteevy was first conquered by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Turned over to the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Empire]] of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], the world was eventually taken by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Seceding during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and aligning with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Anteevy was eventually annexed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the defeat of the Confederacy.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Anteevy.png|thumb|left|The ''Moldy Crow'' approached Anteevy during the Dark Trooper campaign.]]

As the Empire began to build up its [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] ordered the construction of the [[Ice Station Beta/Legends|Imperial Robotics Construction Facility]] known as Ice Station Beta. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Imperials refined the [[Phrik/Legends|phrik alloys]] that were mined from the world, manufacturing specially-modified cold-weather [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] for use on frozen battlefronts.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> In addition to the AT-AT, the defected Imperial officer [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] reported to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|second stage]] of the [[Dark Trooper Project]] was likely taking place on the frozen world. Dispatching Rebel agent [[Kyle Katarn]] to handle the situation, the Alliance leaders planned to terminate the project indefinitely. [[Mission to Anteevy|Infiltrating]] the base, Katarn managed to set several [[sequencer charge]]s throughout the facility's thermal exhaust systems and detonate them. The facility off-line, the Empire abandoned the world soon after.<ref name="DF" />

Located along the border of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Zsinj's Empire|Empire]], the world remained neutral after his death, forgotten by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. At the outbreak of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Anteevy was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]] and held until the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] freed the galaxy from the extragalactic warriors. Isolated once again, Anteevy was deep in space controlled by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] as of [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
